svg.text: The habitable zone is a statement about starlight and a bare surface. Everything else it leaves out.
Every temperate planet we can characterise orbits an M dwarf — and every one of those is inside
the tidal-locking line. The zone we can OBSERVE and the zone the theory was BUILT for barely overlap.
And the framework assumes: surface water only (so every ocean world of 5.3 is excluded); a working
carbonate–silicate thermostat (4.6); and cloud albedos nobody can yet compute (4.2).
